title: Zoe, 26: $900 of Gifts Paid Off in 2029

scenes.say: Paid off in 2029. That's Zoe's holiday shopping.
She put $900 of gifts on a card at about 24% APR.
She pays $40 a month. Sounds fine, right?
At that pace, it takes about 31 months to clear.
Those gifts end up costing about $1,210, with $310 of interest.
Next year, she tries a gift fund instead. $75 a month, starting January.
By December, $900 is waiting. No card, no interest.
Will you shop on a card this year? Subscribe so you don't make this mistake on your next paycheck, because $900 of gifts can be paid off in 2029.
